name: crypto-ed25519-keygen
algorithm: std Ed25519 (RFC 8032 5.1.5) key derivation from n 32-byte seeds of splitmix64 bytes (mk/crypto-ed25519-keygen.mk).

skip.c: no std crypto: C has no standard Ed25519
skip.rust: no std crypto: Rust std has no Ed25519; no crate stands in

notes: Work per step: one key per seed, one SHA-512 and one fixed-base multiplication on every side. Mk crypto.Ed25519.FromSeed, Zig KeyPair.generateDeterministic, Go ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed. Keys per second = n / median.

Checksums: from the Go column first (2026-11-07, std-crypto session 2), then every column in `go run ./tools/bench verify` and `verify -publish-size` (see status/std-crypto.md). Not published: no number here is a measurement.
